scope: Current ten A-D questions and complete worked answers, original five selection criteria, student feedback, source qualifications and exports.
method: Primary assistant read plus two separate assistant reviews of the final questions. Existing source records reused; no fresh full-text or expert review claimed.
overall_disposition: Source/format consistency reviewed; feedback alignment partial. This is a curated teaching collection, not a validated hard-reasoning benchmark.

original_criteria_review.source-supported answer: Assistant source-consistency review found no new factual blocker; existing source evidence and its limits are preserved. Not a new full-text or expert validation.
original_criteria_review.fair input: No hidden source prerequisite identified. Q1, Q2 and Q10 retain answer-selection shortcuts; Q3 retains some unnecessary background.
original_criteria_review.reusable biological lesson: Each item has an identifiable lesson. Q1 remains mainly measurement interpretation; advanced biological reasoning is not established.
original_criteria_review.substantive clear reasoning: Complete explanations retained. Unnecessary reasoning remains a concern in Q3; depth and difficulty are unmeasured.
original_criteria_review.variety: Retains assay interpretation, tool selection, five foundational sequence items, probe perturbation and filtered-evidence interpretation. Variety does not imply uniformly advanced difficulty.

Q1.incorporated: Removed unused sequence/variant material and changed the task from a fold read-off to transfer between assay conditions and measured quantities.
Q1.residual: The stem supplies the peak-location versus peak-height distinction; all distractors make rate extrapolations. The correct option can be identified with limited biological reasoning.

Q2.incorporated: The question now addresses whether cellular staining can calibrate fusion delivery, separating localization, substrate and heme-dependent readouts.
Q2.residual: A, B and D each propose unsupported calibration while C rejects it, preserving a reject-the-overclaim shortcut.

Q3.incorporated: The question compares TurboID and miniTurbo for an explicit temporal objective subject to recovery, with a provisional choice and conditions that could reverse it.
Q3.residual: The candidate-change background is not necessary to select B. Discussion of that change and the alternative cumulative-yield objective exceeds the narrow MCQ task.

Q4-Q8.incorporated: The collection explicitly identifies these as foundational sequence interpretation rather than advanced research problems; sequences and qualified inferences are preserved.
Q4-Q8.residual: They have not been made or demonstrated to be difficult. Retaining them satisfies variety, not a claim of advanced reasoning.

Q9.incorporated: Intermediate valency is included in the correct comparison; the worked answer explicitly accepts concentration dependence as another useful priority.
Q9.residual: The options give the valency comparison stronger engagement/detection controls than the concentration alternative. This tests control quality rather than a balanced practical choice between the two approaches.

Q10.incorporated: Removed incidental exact durations/FDR counts and invalid duration normalization; retains relative enrichment for filtering and separates exclusion from localization or function.
Q10.residual: B alone is a qualified practical recommendation; other options assert unsupported localization, occupancy or function. An epistemic wording shortcut remains.

source_and_provenance_checks.Q6_boundary: Hydrophobic-composition call 193-214 is distinguished from annotated helix 193-213; sequence-based topology is not represented as independent experimental boundary validation.
source_and_provenance_checks.Q43758_identity: Wild-type soybean APX; not pea APX or the complete engineered assay construct.
source_and_provenance_checks.Q9_Q10_accessions: P22629 and P06709 restored with native precursor/ancestral-backbone qualifications.
source_and_provenance_checks.authorship: All current questions are source-aware assistant revisions. Human feedback on earlier versions is not final human validation.
source_and_provenance_checks.historical_independent_checks: Standalone solver evidence for the historical Q9/Q10 assertions remains unrecovered; no new blinded check is claimed.

documentation_fix: Replaced stale open-response preparation instructions with current A-D criteria; removed blanket all-criteria-passed wording from the current review record. No grading rubric was added to reader pages.
